title: Introduction to payments
goal: Explain what a payment is, name the four types of payment by speed and settlement, and draw the payer-to-payee flow with the banks in between.
topics: Electronic vs non-electronic · domestic vs cross-border · RTGS vs ACH · the payment journey · clearing, settlement, messaging · fraud validation points

res.t: Wikipedia: Payment system, RTGS, ACH, Clearing, Settlement
res.n: Read these five in order — accurate and free. Search each title on Wikipedia.

res.n: Search 'CPMI glossary'. The dictionary for the whole course — bookmark it.

res.t: RBI — Payment and Settlement Systems FAQ index
res.n: Links the RBI's own FAQs on NEFT, RTGS, cheque clearing and the PSS Act.

res.t: YouTube: 'how payment systems work clearing and settlement explained'

res.t: Podcast: Glenbrook 'Payments on Fire' — any Payments 101 episode

ex: Draw one diagram showing a cheque, an NEFT transfer, an RTGS transfer and a UPI payment side by side. For each, mark where clearing happens, where settlement happens, and whether it is gross or net.
cp: Can you explain to a friend why a cheque takes two days and UPI takes two seconds, using the words clearing and settlement correctly?
